sources.title: NHS Every Mind Matters — Reframing unhelpful thoughts
sources.context: England public-health guidance; no page date asserted
sources.sections: Checking evidence, alternative explanations and the possibility of neutral thoughts
sources.use: Examine evidence behind interpretations without requiring a positive conclusion.
sources.limits: No copied thought record, video inspection, emotional diagnosis, clinical efficacy or guarantee that a changed interpretation resolves a real problem.

sources.title: NHS — Anger
sources.sections: Symptoms, things to try, medical help and abuse-support boundary
sources.use: Notice early changes, allow time before reaction and recognize limits of self-help.
sources.limits: Symptom examples are not unique bodily signatures or exclusion of medical causes. No clinical program, copied breathing exercise, universal help route or causal result in our cases.

sources.title: NHS Every Mind Matters — Facing your fears
sources.context: England public-health guidance; no page date asserted
sources.sections: Gradual approach, ordering situations and repetition
sources.use: A small suitable approach can provide observations about a feared prediction.
sources.limits: Only the gradual-approach concept is used. The page’s fear-halving continuation and reduced-distraction directions are not adopted. Local 4/10 ceiling comes from the preserved source exercise, is not clinical validation or safety clearance, and never overrides actual threat. Access/prescribed supports remain. No video inspected or clinical exposure protocol supplied.

sources.title: NHS — Grief after bereavement or loss
sources.sections: Varied responses, losses beyond bereavement, support and when to seek care
sources.use: Responses to loss vary and appropriate support remains available.
sources.limits: No prescribed stage sequence, recovery timetable, prolonged-grief diagnosis or promise of decreasing intensity. Linked services are not verified for any learner’s location; this case is an ordinary fictional group ending.

sources.title: CCI — Self Compassion
sources.context: Western Australia Centre for Clinical Interventions; page updated 5 September 2019
sources.use: Care can replace habitual global self-criticism.
sources.limits: Only the overview was read, not linked workbook modules, exercises or multimedia. No copied worksheet, biological-mechanism claim, clinical intervention or attribution of our repair scheme to CCI.

sources.title: CCI — Assertiveness
sources.context: Western Australia Centre for Clinical Interventions; page updated 21 October 2019
sources.use: Clear direct expression can respect the other person.
sources.limits: Linked workbook modules were not read or copied. No guarantee of agreement, reduced symptoms, relationship improvement or suitability for unsafe disclosure.

sources.title: NHS Every Mind Matters — Problem solving
sources.context: England public-health guidance; no page date asserted
sources.sections: Specify a plan and review what actually happens
sources.use: Make a bounded action concrete and inspect its outcome.
sources.limits: No relaxation-video inspection or therapy protocol. The hope and setback structures are original; severe distress, trauma and uncontrollable loss are not reduced to solvable tasks. No resilience or causal-effect validation.

sources.title: University of Edinburgh — What? So what? Now what?
sources.sections: Description, interpretation, action and limits of a simple framework
sources.use: Distinguish an experience from its interpretation and an appropriate response.
sources.limits: Underlying books and diagram not inspected. Receiving, grace and plural interpretations come from the canonical competency, not a spiritual or psychological claim from this page.
